_about: English drafted by Claude (claude-code, 2026-10-02) for questions whose editorial source had Romanian only. Faithful to the Romanian meaning and conversational tone; review in the editorial source and republish if changed.

translations.EDU-CASE-009: What would you gladly give someone without ever finding out whether they return the gesture?
translations.EDU-CASE-010: What do you enjoy doing that would change if you started being paid for it?
translations.EDU-CASE-011: What kind of competition motivates you, and what kind takes the fun out of it?
translations.EDU-CASE-012: What would you need to understand about a plan before you could adapt it as you go?
translations.EDU-CASE-013: What would need to exist between you for you to feel like a team, not just people working in the same place?
translations.EDU-CASE-014: When were you helped by someone who always found reasons why an idea wouldn't work?
translations.EDU-CASE-015: What seems urgent every day but rarely still matters a month later?
translations.EDU-CASE-016: When kindness and fairness seem to ask for different things, how do you choose?
translations.EDU-CASE-017: What choice would be harder for you to explain to a child than to an adult?
translations.EDU-CASE-019: How does the way you say "no" change when you know you have a good alternative?
translations.EDU-CASE-020: What does a good agreement for both sides mean to you, beyond splitting the difference?
translations.EDU-CASE-021: Which two circles of people in your life would you like to bring together?
translations.EDU-CASE-023: Where do you draw the line between persuading someone and putting pressure on them?
translations.EDU-CASE-026: What goal would you measure by consistency rather than by the final result?
translations.EDU-CASE-027: Who would you team up with to invent something: someone full of ideas or someone very practical? Why?
translations.EDU-CASE-028: What change was easier for you to accept because you could keep something familiar?
translations.EDU-CASE-030: What choice would you make more easily if you had fewer options?
translations.EDU-CASE-032: What customer experience showed you that someone had understood a need you hadn't clearly expressed?
translations.EDU-CASE-033: What did you keep going with only because you had already invested so much in it?
translations.EDU-CASE-034: What memorable event still shapes your expectations more than you would like?
translations.EDU-CASE-036: When you decide something as a group, do you prefer everyone to vote or the person who knows best to decide? Why?
translations.EDU-CASE-037: What problem did you take on only because you were the first to say "I'll handle it"?
translations.EDU-CASE-038: What would be harder for you to hand over to someone else: something you excel at or something very important?
translations.EDU-CASE-039: What do you need to see after an apology to feel it wasn't just words?
translations.EDU-CASE-040: How do you choose which misunderstandings are worth clearing up and which you can let go?
translations.EDU-CASE-041: What idea did you present too early, before others understood why it would matter?
translations.EDU-CASE-042: What sideways career move would open up more possibilities for you than a promotion?
translations.EDU-CASE-043: Which of your habits helps others make better use of their time?
translations.EDU-CASE-044: How would you bring a conversation back on topic without dampening the speaker's enthusiasm?
translations.EDU-CASE-045: When did the lack of a resource lead you to a more ingenious solution?
translations.EDU-CASE-047: What lesson did you think you had learned, until you caught yourself repeating the same mistake?
translations.EDU-CASE-048: When did you do your part very well, but the shared result still didn't work out?
translations.EDU-CASE-049: What argument that matters to you is hard to fit into a list of pros and cons?
translations.EDU-CASE-050: What good idea did you overlook because the person proposing it seemed unsure?
translations.EDU-CASE-051: Would you judge the same mistake the same way if it were made by a person or by a program? Why?
translations.EDU-CASE-054: What would you organise completely differently in your everyday life if you were starting from scratch today?

SRC-118.from: What languages do you wish you could speak?
SRC-118.to: Which foreign languages would you like to speak? Why?
SRC-118.reason: Source English omitted the second question ("De ce?" / "Why?") and the word "foreign" ("străine").
